observations.text: When DAN-49 is activated, it changes KIR-60 into an active carrier.
An active KIR-60 causes FEX-71 to be emitted.
Whenever FEX-71 reaches MOR-82, that MOR-82 adopts the terminal marker LUP-93.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of FEX-71 through MOR-82 is LUP-93; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims MOR-82 instead carries terminal marker BAD-20.

Rumor claims MOR-10 instead carries terminal marker BAD-38.
